name: Systems that commonly fail inheritance (must be proven, not assumed)

items.note: Most common inheritance failure. Points list and integrated interfaces drift after Cx.
Post-commission signal loss. FAT green does not prove live police/MOI feed.
Misconfiguration at room-by-room scale. Certificate often ≠ loaded config.
Licence gaps or expired keys at opening.
Test-line-to-tank yields an invalid flow certificate.
Covers/clips not removed; nameplate and labels unreadable.
Odour transfer between kitchen/guest zones untested.
Legionella risk near opening after stagnation.
Reduced battery life. Require new batteries + spares at handover.
